acceptance: A current MCP run with compression off on a platform with no defaults compares with a matching CLI run.
Pre-parity MCP bundles are still refused.
context: Heuristic limit recorded at closeout of mcp-bundles-before-parity-fix-not-comparable-20261114. Guardrails: linked worktree (make worktree-create, then make agent-write-preflight), never the primary clone; one PR per repo; no live-cloud runs or credentials in Git or logs; heavy work only via lock-taking entry points or make heavy-run after make heavy-status; never start deliberate host load; comment policy; changelog.d fragment for user-facing change. Re-verify every cited file and line before acting; they are hints.
description:
Problem: PR #4273 makes compare refuse (exit 4) a pair where one side is an MCP bundle with no recorded config.compression or config.platform_options. A post-fix MCP run with compression disabled on a platform with no registered defaults records neither, so it is refused as not comparable.

Outcome: bundles record an explicit capture version or marker so compare tells pre-parity bundles from current ones without inference.
